name: WOL 3D India Ltd
about: Incorporated in November 1988, WOL 3D India Limited provides 3D Printing solutions, which enable easier prototyping[1]
keyPoints:
Business Profile[1] WOL 3D India Limited offers a wide range of 3D printing products and services. Its product portfolio includes:

3D Printers: The company distributes well-known brands like Bambu Lab, Creality, Flashforge, and UltiMaker.
3D Scanners: These are used to digitize physical objects into 3D models.
3D Pens: These pens allow users to create three-dimensional objects by extruding heated plastic filaments.
Laser Engravers: Devices for etching designs on different surfaces.
Consumables: The company manufactures high-quality filaments like ABS and PLA, which are key materials for 3D printing.
Prototyping Services: They offer advanced services using FDM, SLA, and SLS technologies, providing CAD modeling, reverse engineering, and vacuum casting solutions.[2][3][4]

pros: Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 36.3%
Debtor days have improved from 47.9 to 36.6 days.
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Earnings include an other income of Rs.2.46 Cr.
